review.notes: Triage pass within a fixed time budget. (a) Whole-document structural scan of all 3351 OCR lines: all 8 code fences balanced with no swallowed headings/tables/images; four in-figure chart titles and two callout-box labels were promoted to headings (patched). (b) Machine droppage scan of all 246 physical pages (normalized word 4-gram containment against the OCR markdown): 23 pages below 0.85 containment; the 12 lowest (25, 113, 229, 205, 167, 228, 196, 14, 198, 203, 217, 194) were inspected line-by-line against the extracted PDF text. (c) Every patch below was verified on a rendered page that was visually read (110-120 dpi): pages 14, 25, 113, 179, 180, 194, 212, 214, 229, 238. Pages 1-246 were machine-scanned, not read line-by-line. Footnote bodies are systematically absent from the OCR document-wide; only the pages listed above were visually verified, so only those footnotes are patched here. Remaining mid-containment pages (150, 196-203, 219-220, 225-226, 228-229) had line-level inspection only where listed.
